[CameraKit Web SDK](../globals.md) / WasmAssetUrls

# Interface: WasmAssetUrls

URLs of the WebAssembly assets required to run the rendering engine: the WebAssembly binary
and its JS glue file. Accepted by the `lensCoreOverrideUrls` configuration option and produced
by createBootstrapURLs.
